title: Concept: Script import from a plaintext module
description: A module import that resolves to plaintext HTTP in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The imported module is the code that runs the page, so an unauthenticated import is remote code execution from the network path.
applicability: Deployments that render a module import that resolves to plaintext HTTP into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The imported module is the code that runs the page, so an unauthenticated import is remote code execution from the network path.
